findings.evidence: Evertse.lean:142-143 `(by rintro v (⟨w, rfl⟩ | ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩) <;> simp [*])`, twice.
findings.fix: Write both branches explicitly, as the next argument (lines 144-147) already does: `· exact hνinf w` / `· exact hνfin u hu`, and `· exact hμinf w` / `· exact hμfin u hu`.
findings.issue: `rintro v (⟨w, rfl⟩ | ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩) <;> simp [*]` (lines 142 and 143) closes the positivity and monotonicity side goals by simp over the whole local context, including the `set` equations `hT` and `hA`. Which hypothesis does the work is hidden, and the step breaks if the context or the simp set changes.

findings.evidence: Lines 416 and 421: `(mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left (hν v hv i)).mp ((v.nonneg _).trans (hLx v hv i l))`.
findings.fix: State `hμ₀ : ∀ v ∈ T, ∀ l, 0 ≤ μ v l` once before `key` and use it in both places.
findings.issue: Nonnegativity of `μ v l` is derived twice with the same term, once inside `key` (line 416) and again in the final `h₀` (line 421).

findings.evidence: Lines 130-134: `have h := hv q 0; rw [add_zero, map_zero, max_eq_left …] at h; nlinarith`. Its caller `exists_triangular` has `hc : 1 ≤ c`.
findings.fix: Add a hypothesis `hc : 0 ≤ c` (or `1 ≤ c`) and pass `zero_le_one.trans hc` from `exists_triangular`.
findings.issue: `apply_sub_div_mul_le` gets `0 ≤ c` by instantiating `hv q 0` and calling `nlinarith`. This hides a simple fact behind an indirect argument, even though the only caller already has `1 ≤ c`.

findings.evidence: Line 241 `have hIio : Set.Iio ls = {l : Fin n | l.val < s} := Set.ext fun _ ↦ Fin.lt_def`; line 402 `rwa [show Set.Iio j = {l : Fin m | l.val < j.val} from Set.ext fun _ ↦ Fin.lt_def] at this`.
findings.fix: Factor it into one private lemma `Set.Iio j = {l | l.val < j.val}` and use it at both sites.
findings.issue: The rewrite `Set.Iio j = {l : Fin n | l.val < j.val}` via `Set.ext fun _ ↦ Fin.lt_def` is repeated at lines 241 and 402. It is needed only because the gluing lemma indexes by `l.val < s` while its callers use `Set.Iio`.

summary: Proofs are mostly robust and the long proofs carry step comments, but two goals are closed by context-wide `simp [*]` and some small facts are re-derived or hidden instead of passed in or factored out.
